notes.title: A Place for the Unwilling - Patch #19
notes.notes:
Hello fellow citizens,

Here we are with another game patch that fixes a few issues you reported. Thanks a lot for helping us to take care of our lovely city :)

Please stay tuned because great news are coming next month...

Don't forget we have a Discord server in case you want to join us there as well and share your thoughts on the game.

Critical fixes
-Saul's funeral does now have a diary entry.
-The mission "Painaway" can be completed correctly now.
-The player can now keep the earnings of the mission "Painaway" without triggering wrong dialogue lines when talking to strangers the following days.

Small fixes
-The player must now talk to Wallace to start a major event during last Saturday.
-The player can now convince Myles to go to their house during last Saturday.
-If the player is in the theatre scenary at 23:00 on day 14, they get teleported to the theatre play.
-Dana does no longer repeat a sentence during the mission "Migraine."
-Dialogue works correctly now when the player doesn't found the potato of the corpses in the first attempt.

Style fixes
-The player can't now go trough a courtain inside the hospital room.
-The portrait of one of the guests in Dana's party does now show correctly.
-A sprite does now appear on the outside of Hoyt's Antiques and General Store after the mission "A child for a day."
-A description is displayed now when the player interacts with the theatre ticket.

notes.title: A Place for the Unwilling - Patch #18
notes.notes:
Hello fellow citizens,

While the situation out there is still tough, we want to bring you a brand new patch for you to enjoy A Place for the Unwilling as you deserve. A lot of major fixes and improvements have been made in order to get the game ready for... a new year and a new life!

Leave your comments below and reach us to let us know your thoughts on the game and the new fixes!

Remember to leave a positive rating on Steam if you're enjoying the game. That'd help A LOT a small studio like ours.

Don't forget we also have a Discord server in case you want to join us there as well.


Critical fixes
-The player can get stuck in the hospital room if he refuses to accept the mission "Interview behind bars".
-The game no longer blocks when they exit the house on Day 18.
-The game no longer blocks when talking to the factory guy during the mission "Keeping my ears peeled".
-The player can no longer get stuck inside the corpse od the Park on Day 13.
-The clock does no longer stop after the conversation with the Master.
-No wrong dialogue is displayed after the player keeps the earnings of the mission "Painaway".
-The player does no longer appear floating while seated if they save and exit during the funeral of Saul.
-The game does no longer block when the player asks Juliet about Henry's dead during the mission "The Second Time".
-The game does no longer block when the player sends the first letter to Juliet.
-The game does no longer block during the first conversation with Gail during the mission "The crown".

-The player can now talk to Giles and Myles about Gail without depending on having a newspaper to buy or a conversation to have.
-The player can no longer start a major mission during Day 20 without talking to Wallace.
-The player can no longer get stuck during the conversation with the Merry Brats during the mission "Smoky and delicious".
-The theatre keeps burned down after immediately leaving the scene and coming back.
-The player can no longer get stuck at the beginning of Day 13.


Smaller fixes
-The player can now change tabs by using the arrows or the stick in the Documents Menu.
-The diary is now updated with the murders mission.
-The mission "The Trade" can now be properly finished when the player accepts the deal.
-A dialogue option is no longer incomplete when talking with Harriet about Florence.
-The text after the handshake with Myles during the mission "Consoling the inconsolable" is now correctly displayed.
-All dialogue options during the first letter the player writes to Juliet are now correctly displayed.
-All dialogue options during the mission "In the eye of the hurricane" are now correctly displayed.
-All dialogue options during the conversation with the Master are now correctly displayed.
-The word "PLAYER" is no longer displayed during the first conversation with August.
-The word "PLAYER" is no longer displayed when the player interacts with the table inside the Allen's living room.
-The player can no longer go trough the curtains inside the hospital room.
-All dialogue options during the mission "Down with the Union!" are now correctly displayed.
-The player can no longer go through the fences of the cemetery.
-The player can no longer go through the walls of the bazaar.
-The player can no longer go through elements of the last scene of the game such as props, walls, etc.

-Lloyd tells the player to meet him at 22.30 instead of 22.00 during the mission "He will call us".
-Saul does no longer repeat his dialogue about the White Boat if he already did.

-The player can't talk back to Giles after failing the mission "One sip is enough".
-The player can no longer skip the mission "Interview behind bars" by going to the cemetery right after leaving the house.

-The player can no longer drink Dana's potion if the bottle is empty.

notes.title: A Place for the Unwilling - Patch #16
notes.notes:
Hello fellow citizens,

It's been a while since the last major update but we are still working on the game. A Place for the Unwilling launched more than a year ago but we are still polishing things and trying to offer you the best experience possible. Oh, and by the way... stay tuned because we have big plans for the future!
We will share more info during the following months.

Remember to leave a positive rating on Steam if you're enjoying the game. That'd help A LOT a small studio like ours.

Don't forget we also have a Discord server in case you want to join us there as well.

Patch #16

Critical fixes
-The player no longer gets stuck when exiting the alley between the Police Station and the City Hall in the central quarter.
-The game no longer freezes when the player accepts the first drink Dana offers to them.
-The game no longer freezes after displaying the stomachache message.
-The player can no longer get stuck behind a chair in the first crime scene.
-The player does no longer get stuck with the corpse found inside The Orchard.

-The player can no longer go through some walls in Juliet's bedroom.
-The player can no longer go trough a shelf inside the Top Hat Club.
-The player can no longer trigger the newsstand explossion infinite times by talking to Giles.
-The diary does now correctly update with the mission "Dreams of Ink".
-The player can no longer go trough a wall inside the lighthouse.
-The game does now respond well to the player decision on killing Harriet's chicken.
-The player can no longer go trough the empty cage inside Harriet's shop.

-The day does now update correctly (Day 14, Sunday) after finishing the ritual.

-The dialogue with the sailor during a Myles' mission is now fixed.
-The player is no longer overlapped by a chair during the funeral.
-The player is no longer able to walk over the hole of the grave.
-The dialogue with Harriet about Juliet on Day 16 is now fixed.
-The text displayed when interacting with the pills inside Juliet's bedroom is now the right one.
-The player can no longer receive the third letter from Juliet if she's no longer alive.
-The player can no longer go through the walls of the hospital secret room.
-The conversation with Florence during day 20 does work correctly now.
-August gives now the player the right directions to find him where Turbot Street meets Wool Street.

-Fixed a dialogue line in the mission "Interview behind bars"
-Fixed a dialogue line in the ission "Drinking from Lethe"
-All the diary descriptions are now correctly displayed.

notes.title: A Place for the Unwilling - Patch #14
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34896298/735113fc00e3b7dbd99837948513d228ee0220c8.jpg

Hi!

We just uploaded a new patch correcting many of the issues reported by players. Keep in mind that you might need to restart Steam for the client to search for updates.

Remember to leave a positive rating on Steam if you're enjoying the game. That'd help A LOT a small studio like ours.

All the changes are listed below, but you can check the status of all the reports on our public trello board. We use it to track every bug report.

Don't forget we also have a Discord server in case you want to join us there as well.

New feature: Map markers
While we don't plan to add more content to A Place for the Unwilling, we collect every piece of feedback and add it to our trello board in case we can implement new things requested by players (which is very tricky given our limited resources).

After today's update, you can toggle markers on the map screen. You'll still need to use your wits to find your way around the city, but things like finding public buildings or telling where each quarter ends should be easier now.

You can activate these markers pressing "A" on your keyboard (or "X" if you are using a Xbox gamepad) from the map screen. We've updated the interface to show this new function.

Gamescom and update schedule:
There won't be any new patches in the next 7-8 days or so. We also might not be able to answer every message next week. The reason for this being that some of us will be at Gamescom showing the game around and a few of us will be taking days off in order to rest from all the work we've been doing lately and stay healthy.

If you're attending Gamescom be sure to drop by the Indie Arena Booth (Hall 10.2) and say hi. A Place for the Unwilling is part of the showcase and we'll be around.

Critical fixes:

 Moved a group of static shadows that could trap the player in the poor quarter.
 Lucas' event that involves translating a text no longer adds a journal entry that says you've failed before starting the task.
 The instructions for finding August on day 13 have been corrected.
 Newspapers now show a visual hint reminding players they can use arrow keys (or the joystick) to turn the pages.
 The trading interface has a new visual hint to remind players it's possible to scroll down the page.


Smaller fixes:

 Fixed a bug that kept triggering the "Item added to your iventory" notification with a certain book.
 Tweaked a few lines of "Making a mess" that could give a wrong impression.
 The journal entry from day 14 now shows the time at which the play will start.
 Players will now get more precise instructions for finding Emily on day 14.
 There's a thing in the inner library that can look like a bug even though it's working as intended. A small hint has been added to let players know things "might be odd in there".
 Corrected the journal entries from the second week that mentioned "a second corpse".
 More pronoun corrections (English and Spanish).


Style changes:

 Henry's Will no longer mentions Arthur.
 Corrected several typos (English version).
 Corrected some documents (images) that had typos (English version).


We hope you are enjoying the game and that these patches are making the experience smoother for everyone.

notes.title: A Place for the Unwilling - Patch #8
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34896298/735113fc00e3b7dbd99837948513d228ee0220c8.jpg

Hi!

We just uploaded a new patch correcting many of the issues reported by players. Keep in mind that you might need to restart Steam for the client to search for updates.

Remember to leave a positive rating on Steam if you're enjoying the game. That'd help A LOT a small studio like ours.

All the changes are listed below, but you can check the status of all the reports on our public trello board. We use it to track every bug report.

You can expect more patches as we fix and polish things based on player reports. Don't forget we also have a Discord server in case you want to join us there as well.

Technical mumbo jumbo:

A Place for the Unwilling uses a narrative scripting tool to handle every dialogue in the game. It's called Ink and it was developed by the folks behind 80 days.

We used this patch to update the version of ink we had in the project. Updating middleware is always tricky and delicate, but we realized the version we were using would get in the way of certain tweaks and fixes we were making for the game.

So we spent a good chunk of our time today implementing the new version and polishing rough edges. This should help those having issues with save files from pre-release versions and make it easier for us to fix some bugs reported by users.

Critical fixes:

 Updated Inkle plugin (now using the last version).
 Corrected map enter/exit triggers.
 Reviewed Hoyt's NPC spawners.
 Books should now be added to your inventory (just like newspapers) after inspecting them.


Lesser fixes:

 Players will no longer wake after 1 PM (even if you stay up late).
